p1: Part 1 of 2. New episode: Moses and the Burning Bush. Make 12 separate wide 16:9 images, same soft 3D style, warm light and same Eliora characters as before, gentle and child-friendly, no text. Setting: a quiet desert mountainside with golden rocks, green grass, a few sheep and goats, warm sunset sky. Moses: a kind man with short dark hair and a short dark beard, a brown robe with a tan sash, a wooden shepherd's staff, no grey beard. The burning bush: a small green bush glowing with gentle golden-orange flames that never harm it, warm and never scary. Aaron: a friendly man with a short dark beard in a cream and blue robe. IMPORTANT: porch scenes use Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli and Pip in exactly their reference-sheet outfits (mustard cardigan and round gold glasses; green dress with yellow ribbons; red-white striped T-shirt and blue shorts; lamb with gold bell on blue ribbon). Story scenes must NOT include Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli or Pip, and no grey-bearded old man in story scenes. 1) Grandpa Sol's porch with a small glowing porch heater, Zara pointing and telling Eli to be careful, Eli holding out his hands, Pip curled up, Grandpa Sol smiling. 2) Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli and Pip cozy together on the porch bench under a blanket, Eli curious, golden evening light, Grandpa Sol starting the story. 3) Moses walking with his flock of sheep across a quiet golden desert at dawn, his wooden staff in hand, peaceful. 4) Moses sitting on a rock under the shade of a tree, sheep resting around him, a gentle smile. 5) Moses leading his sheep up the side of a big mountain, rocks and green grass, warm midday sun. 6) A close-up of Moses looking surprised, pointing toward something off to the side, sheep watching. 7) The small bush glowing with gentle golden-orange flames that don't burn the green leaves, a soft magical glow on the rocks. 8) Moses walking slowly toward the bush with wonder, his face lit by the golden glow. 9) A close-up of the glowing bush with green leaves and soft golden light, warm and wonderful. 10) Moses stopping and taking off his sandals, kneeling on the soft grass, a gentle light shining on him. 11) Moses covering his face with his hands out of respect, the bush glowing softly beside him. 12) A wide shot of Moses kneeling before the glowing bush on the mountain, sheep watching quietly, a golden sky. Create all 12 as separate cartoon images in the same soft 3D style (not realistic).

t: Make one wide 16:9 title image in the same soft 3D style as the story: Grandpa Sol's cozy porch at golden hour, Zara, Eli and Pip smiling and holding paper lanterns while Grandpa Sol points to a small glowing candle bush on a table. In the foreground, a big carved wooden sign lettered exactly "GOD IS WITH ME" in big clear capital letters, and below it a cream ribbon banner lettered exactly "MOSES AND THE BURNING BUSH". No other text, no watermark. Place the sign and ribbon so they do not cover any character's head or face. Use a warm palette of orange, gold, cream and soft green, with the same reference-sheet outfits as before.
